label: Finance
hook: Turn a KYC exception queue into a cited, approval-ready risk decision.
intent: Triage 1,248 KYC exceptions, verify sanctions exposure, and prepare the escalation pack before market open.
trigger: A nightly screening run flags contradictory ownership and sanctions evidence.
checkpoint: A compliance officer approves 37 high-risk escalations.
outcome: 1,248 cases triaged; 37 accounts held with an evidence trail.
codeTask: Validate risk scores and evidence completeness inside an isolated Python sandbox.
message: @ahi compare the exception batch with policy, sanctions updates, and prior SAR rationale. Stop before any account hold.
agentReply: Evidence fused across policy, sanctions, and ledger sources. 37 cases exceed the escalation threshold; human approval is required.

label: Legal
hook: Review a data-processing agreement without losing privilege, precedent, or the clause-level evidence.
intent: Compare a 96-page vendor DPA against approved fallback language and draft a negotiation brief.
trigger: A strategic vendor returns a redline hours before procurement review.
checkpoint: General Counsel approves five non-standard positions before response.
outcome: 23 deviations classified; five clauses held for counsel judgment.
codeTask: Diff clause semantics and citation coverage without exposing the matter outside its sandbox.
message: @ahi compare the vendor redline to our approved positions. Preserve privilege and stop on non-standard liability terms.
agentReply: 23 deviations are mapped to approved language and precedent. Five liability and transfer positions require counsel approval.

label: Manufacturing
hook: Trace a quality deviation from sensor anomaly to supplier containment before the next shift.
intent: Investigate torque drift on Line 4, identify affected lots, and prepare a containment decision.
trigger: Edge sensors detect a statistically significant torque shift across two production lots.
checkpoint: The quality director approves line containment and supplier notification.
outcome: Two lots isolated; the line remains running under a bounded control plan.
codeTask: Run change-point detection across edge telemetry in an isolated analytics sandbox.
message: @ahi correlate the torque drift with lots, supplier changes, and FMEA controls. Do not stop the line without approval.
agentReply: The anomaly begins with two lots tied to supplier batch Q17. A bounded containment plan is ready for quality approval.

label: Customer Support
hook: Resolve a ticket surge with consistent policy, product context, and accountable exceptions.
intent: Classify 2,406 billing tickets, resolve known cases, and isolate refund exceptions for human review.
trigger: A billing migration produces a six-hour spike across chat, email, and community channels.
checkpoint: Support leads approve refunds above policy and review vulnerable-customer cases.
outcome: Routine cases receive grounded drafts; 86 sensitive exceptions stay human-owned.
codeTask: Cluster de-identified ticket intent and detect outliers in a scoped analytics sandbox.
message: @ahi group the billing surge, ground each draft in account history and policy, and hold every sensitive exception.
agentReply: 2,320 routine responses are grounded and ready. 86 refunds, vulnerable-customer, and ambiguous cases remain with human leads.

label: Logistics
hook: Replan a disrupted network while cost, service commitments, and human authority remain visible.
intent: Reroute 312 shipments around a port closure without breaking cold-chain or priority SLAs.
trigger: A port closure removes two planned sailings and strands priority inventory.
checkpoint: Network operations approves high-cost air conversions and customer commitments.
outcome: 288 shipments replanned; 24 costly exceptions await operator approval.
codeTask: Compare feasible route sets under service, capacity, and cost constraints.
message: @ahi rebuild the shipment plan around the port closure. Preserve cold-chain and stop before premium freight commitments.
agentReply: 288 shipments have feasible alternatives. 24 premium moves and service exceptions require operations approval.

label: E-commerce
hook: Protect margin and customer trust when returns, fraud, and inventory signals collide.
intent: Investigate a returns anomaly, identify abuse patterns, and preserve legitimate customer resolutions.
trigger: Return rates double across one category after a promotion and catalog update.
checkpoint: Commerce operations approves rule changes and high-value account actions.
outcome: Three abuse patterns isolated without auto-blocking legitimate customers.
codeTask: Model cohort anomalies without exposing direct customer identifiers.
message: @ahi explain the return spike using orders, promotion rules, and catalog changes. Do not block customers automatically.
agentReply: Three coordinated abuse patterns are isolated. Legitimate sizing-related returns remain separated for customer-first resolution.

label: SaaS
hook: Turn fragmented product, support, and security signals into an accountable renewal plan.
intent: Prepare the renewal plan for a strategic account with adoption risk and an open security review.
trigger: Usage drops while procurement sends a 184-question security assessment.
checkpoint: The account team approves commitments, pricing exceptions, and security representations.
outcome: Renewal risk is explained with owners, evidence, and no invented commitments.
codeTask: Calculate feature adoption and cohort drift in an isolated customer analytics sandbox.
message: @ahi prepare the renewal plan from usage, tickets, contract terms, and approved security evidence. Never invent a commitment.
agentReply: Twelve renewal risks now have evidence and owners. Pricing, roadmap, and security representations remain at human checkpoints.

label: Fashion
hook: Coordinate trend evidence, margin, supplier readiness, and brand judgment before the line locks.
intent: Rebalance the autumn capsule using sell-through, trend, margin, and supplier compliance signals.
trigger: Early trend signals diverge from the approved buy while two suppliers miss readiness gates.
checkpoint: Merchandising approves assortment changes and every brand-sensitive creative decision.
outcome: A revised capsule preserves margin and supplier readiness without automating taste.
codeTask: Model SKU-level margin and inventory scenarios without replacing creative judgment.
message: @ahi compare the capsule against sell-through, trend, margin, and supplier readiness. Keep brand judgment with merchandising.
agentReply: Eighteen SKU decisions are framed with economics and evidence. Assortment and creative choices remain with the merchandising team.

label: Healthcare
hook: Coordinate discharge readiness while clinical judgment and patient context stay visible.
intent: Assemble the discharge plan, unresolved risks, medication changes, and follow-up owners before the patient leaves.
trigger: A discharge order arrives while medication reconciliation and specialist follow-up remain incomplete.
checkpoint: A licensed clinician confirms readiness and resolves the remaining exceptions.
outcome: The care team receives one cited handoff with ownership and unresolved risk visible.
codeTask: Check evidence completeness and ownership without making a clinical decision.
message: @ahi assemble the discharge handoff, show every unresolved risk, and stop for licensed clinical review.
agentReply: Patient context, medication changes, and follow-up ownership are assembled. Clinical readiness remains at the human checkpoint.
